item.title: Brett Larson Emerges As Top Candidate For Gophers' Hockey Coaching Position
item.description: The University of Minnesota is looking for a new men's hockey coach after Bob Motzko's retirement, with Brett Larson emerging as a strong candidate from St. Cloud State.

item.title: Tips For Securing Your Home From Hungry Bears This Spring
item.description: As bears shake off winter in Minnesota, they're in search of food. Residents should follow these tips to keep yard bear-free.

item.title: Minnesota Lawmakers Vote To End Housing Program Amid Ongoing Scrutiny Over Fraud
item.description: In a unanimous vote, Minnesota's House of Representatives decided to scrap the Housing Stabilization Services program amid alarming fraud investigations that have led to $243 million in withheld Medicaid funds.

item.description: A devastating fire in White Bear Lake took the lives of sports personality Jessi Pierce, her three children, and their dog, leaving the community in mourning and supporting her husband, Mike.

item.title: Chevy Express Van Collides With Parked Box Truck in Eden Lake Township
item.description: A morning crash in Eden Lake Township pinned a driver inside his van after colliding with a parked box truck, but thankfully he only suffered minor injuries.
